consequence.statement: The deprecated storage options, including the BoltDB store, are deprecated in Loki 3.0.0. The evidence does not say when they will be removed.

assertion.statement: Several storage options are deprecated, including the BoltDB store, but the text names no exact configuration key.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: Text names 'storage options' and the BoltDB store but gives no config key or identifier to spell exactly; it may also bundle several options.; applicability: Evidence does not say which configuration identifies use of the deprecated storage options.
